report: Biopsy shows dense eosinophilic infiltrate without vasculitis/radiation changes; peripheral eosinophilia 11%; recent endometrial adenocarcinoma; no new drugs/exposures. These strongly support paraneoplastic eosinophilic dermatosis, excluding radiation dermatitis, drug/contact hypersensitivity, and urticarial vasculitis. Pending serologic markers, staging, infection/hematologic exclusion limit certainty, but leading diagnosis is paraneoplastic eosinophilic dermatosis.
answer: Eosinophilic, polymorphic, and pruritic eruption associated with radiotherapy (EPPER)
